description_en: Query room details, including hotel information, guest control information, CatGenie device information, guest service requests, and more
description_zh: 房间详情查询，查询包含酒店信息、客控信息、猫精设备信息、客需信息等
name: QueryHotelRoomDetail

parameters.help_en:
Device MAC address  
Note: If MAC, UUID, and SN are all provided, the system queries based on the correctly entered values. If all provided values are valid, the query Priority follows the order: UUID > MAC > SN.  
If any one of MAC, UUID, or SN is provided, the hotel ID and channel number do not need to be provided.
parameters.help_zh:
设备mac地址
注：若在mac uuid sn全都输入的情况下 按照输入正确的内容查询 若全输入都是正确的 则 按照 uuid > mac > sn 优先级查询
传入mac uuid sn其中一个 则酒店id和房间号可不传
parameters.name: mac

parameters.help_en:
Device UUID, which can be viewed in the App  
Note: If MAC, UUID, and SN are all provided, the system queries based on the correctly entered values. If all inputs are valid, the query priority is UUID > MAC > SN.  
If any one of MAC, UUID, or SN is provided, the hotel ID and room number are optional.
parameters.help_zh:
设备uuid，可在App中查看
注：若在mac uuid sn全都输入的情况下 按照输入正确的内容查询 若全输入都是正确的 则 按照 uuid > mac > sn 优先级查询
传入mac uuid sn其中一个 则酒店id和房间号可不传
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
Hotel ID  
Note: When querying using the hotel ID and channel number, the query Priority is lower than when providing the device SN, MAC, or UUID. If none of SN, MAC, or UUID are provided, the hotel ID must be provided.
parameters.help_zh:
酒店id
注：使用酒店id 房间号查询 查询优先级低于传入设备sn mac uuid，若sn mac uuid都未传 则酒店id必传
parameters.name: hotel_id

parameters.help_en:
Room number  
Note: When querying using hotel ID and room number, the query priority is lower than when providing device SN, MAC, or UUID. If none of SN, MAC, or UUID are provided, the room number must be specified.
parameters.help_zh:
房间号
注：使用酒店id 房间号查询 查询优先级低于传入设备sn mac uuid，若sn mac uuid都未传 则房间号必传
parameters.name: room_no

parameters.help_en:
设备sn信息
注：若在mac uuid sn全都输入的情况下 按照输入正确的内容查询 若全输入都是正确的 则 按照 uuid > mac > sn 优先级查询
传入mac uuid sn其中一个 则酒店id和房间号可不传
parameters.help_zh:
设备sn信息
注：若在mac uuid sn全都输入的情况下 按照输入正确的内容查询 若全输入都是正确的 则 按照 uuid > mac > sn 优先级查询
传入mac uuid sn其中一个 则酒店id和房间号可不传
parameters.name: sn
